I looked at several dead multiplayer games and online games with little to no players left and I tried to uncover the reasons behind these games losing players and whether any of them are worth revisiting. As I played these dead games such as Squad 44, Sunkenland, Chivalry: Medieval Warfare and Digital Paint: Paintball 2 I concluded whether or not these possibly forgotten Steam games deserve any new players or if they are truly as dead as people claim them to be.
